title: Governed typography and color themes

story.need: customize typography and color across the whole site without introducing one-off styling
story.outcome: every block and chrome variant shares a coherent, accessible, publishable visual language

scope: Configure Google Fonts for display, body, and monospace roles
Configure semantic color tokens and governed named schemes
Apply theme tokens to blocks, header, footer, banners, previews, and published pages
Version theme changes inside the existing site-settings draft and publish workflow
Validate color values, Google Font family names, and critical foreground/background contrast
nonGoals: Applying the public theme to the CMS administration interface
dataRequirements: Font roles store a validated Google Fonts family and explicit supported weights
Colors are six-digit hexadecimal values assigned to semantic roles
Named schemes map semantic foreground, background, muted, accent, and border roles
Blocks select only registered schemes supported by their variant
permissions: Anonymous visitors read the published theme only
Authenticated editors may change the theme draft
Publishing the theme requires cms:publish through MCP

then: Google Fonts are loaded from fonts.googleapis.com using one deduplicated request
semantic CSS variables are applied to the public site only
all page blocks and site chrome inherit the published theme

acceptanceCriteria.given: an invalid color, unsafe font family, or inaccessible critical color pair
acceptanceCriteria.when: an editor or MCP client saves settings
then: the shared domain schema rejects the draft with field-level issues
the previous draft and published theme remain unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.when: Inter, Playfair Display, and its semantic palette are configured
then: the theme model represents the identity without raw block-level overrides

fixtures: Imran site theme using Inter, Playfair Display, navy, cream, copper, mist, and sand
verification: Theme schema and contrast unit tests
Public theme responsive and accessibility scan
